# Data Slayer Tutorials

> Practical, copy-paste tutorials for scraping and automating social platforms with Apify actors — no login required.

## What this site is

Step-by-step guides for using Apify actors to collect public data from LinkedIn, Instagram,
Facebook, TikTok and X, and to automate those flows with n8n, Make, or Zapier.

## Key pages

- Home: https://dataslayer.dev/
- Tutorials index: https://dataslayer.dev/
- Sitemap: https://dataslayer.dev/sitemap.xml

## Tutorials

- Scrape LinkedIn company posts without cookies: https://dataslayer.dev/tutorials/scrape-linkedin-company-posts-without-cookies/
- Pull Instagram post and reel analytics by URL: https://dataslayer.dev/tutorials/instagram-post-and-reel-analytics-by-url/
- Refresh your CRM with fresh LinkedIn profile data: https://dataslayer.dev/tutorials/refresh-your-crm-with-fresh-linkedin-profile-data/
- Find warm intro paths into any LinkedIn account: https://dataslayer.dev/tutorials/find-warm-intro-paths-into-any-linkedin-account/
- Build an Instagram creator lead list from keywords: https://dataslayer.dev/tutorials/build-an-instagram-creator-lead-list-from-keywords/

## Actor pages

One page per data-slayer actor (95), each with inputs, outputs, pricing, a runnable example and a one-click run link:

- Actor pages index: https://dataslayer.dev/actors/
- Example: https://dataslayer.dev/actors/instagram-post-details/

## Notes

- All tutorials use Apify actors; no login/cookies are required for the public-data flows.
- Every actor also has a page under /actors/<slug>/ with inputs, outputs and pricing.
- Contact: Mayank Chaba.
